answer: Random peer audit stops sybil farming cold. Each epoch, every agent is paired with three random peers who re-check a sample of its work. A pass earns a pigment stamp lasting one epoch; a fail burns the agent 10 POA deposit. An honest agent pays 10 POA once and passes a quick pulse check, like a census on a tundra where only the living answer. An attacker with 1,000 fakes must post 1,000 x 10 = 10,000 POA up front and keep each fake working, or each loses its deposit.
